scope: Fresh open selection, source writing/review, definition comparison, isolated registry admission and graph projection on nine preserved accepted workflows.

definition_comparisons.boundary: These are definition-identity decisions archived with admission, not new assay-to-assay mechanism correspondence edges.

usage_boundary: Accumulated provider counts include repeated/cached context; no unique-paper volume or dollar-cost inference.

archive.boundary: Exact registered original bytes are preserved; many registered originals are renditions. This does not establish complete conversion lineage or rereview imported historical claims.

lineage_recovery.boundary: Neither archive changed. Fresh remote check verified the sidecar hash and baseline size/receipt; source-chain hashes were independently checked in the local immutable baseline copy.

issues.finding: Both predeclared DBiT/SPLiT shared library-preparation questions were missed again by open selection. No multi-method shared mechanism reached admission.
issues.next: Test existing definition-targeted nested-region retrieval separately from open discovery; do not require a predetermined positive edge.

issues.finding: All ten source/definition reviews were positive, but scBS adapter-copying shorthand remained ambiguous, and not every free-text preserved property was individually source-addressed.
issues.next: Evaluate molecular-feature origin and unsupported property controls at clause level; do not label ambiguous shorthand as demonstrated invented chemistry.

issues.finding: Fresh membership reviews decline inherited categorical analytical-aliquot non-return instructions in ATAC and Drop, while final graph retains those original parent clauses. Positive concept membership does not repair the extraction.
issues.next: Require fresh parent correction/review or explicit machine-readable claim restrictions before publishing these raw records for design use.
issues.contract_boundary: The membership contract can accept a supported definition while declining extraneous raw clauses. The defect is propagation of known-negative findings to raw retrieval, not invalidity of every admitted membership.

issues.finding: DR exclusion from the origin-purpose group follows a deliberately narrow definition; it does not establish absence of the broader origin-preservation purpose.
issues.next: Evaluate overlapping retrieval purposes, not just internally consistent exclusive-looking categories.

issues.finding: Two selector commands emitted about 1.08 million raw characters because evidence text remained nested in bindings/resources.
issues.fix: Scoped workflow/evidence navigation implemented in 49d8938; 2,164 local software tests passed, 3 skipped. Native latency/behavior improvement not measured.

issues.finding: 21 pairs require189 field judgments; 10 pairs already differ in exact relation type.
issues.next: Use an explicit typed non-equivalence witness when sufficient for admission; retain unknown/unassessed fields and do not infer disjointness.

issues.finding: Current archive has 28 lineage flags. Compared with baseline by source hash/reason, 24 are shared, 4 hiCLIP flags leave scope and 4 ATAC/Drop rendition ancestors become newly unlocated. The comparison intake did not carry all existing original-binding records.
issues.next: Recover existing bindings from the prior durable archive without rewriting completed results; propagate typed lineage through future stage handoffs.
issues.recovery: Four exact rendition/PDF/binding/ledger chains recovered in lineage_recovery.json and durably preserved; 24 other archival flags remain. Future handoffs still need automatic binding propagation.

positive_behaviors: Four complete fresh native threads, no duplicate IDs, current scientific rules present in three scientific prompts.
All ten exact cut memberships and28operation links preserve original workflow/source versions.
Purpose sharing is not promoted into mechanism sharing, ancestry or substitution.
Source writer corrected a mechanically rejected nonmatching quote; source reviewer corrected missing citation coverage before completion.
ATAC membership does not adopt the old unsupported analytical-aliquot prohibition; ddRAD review explicitly separates cleanup-order variants.
release_decision: Bounded comparison experiment completed. Scientific coverage, parent-claim handling and lineage propagation still prevent treating this as a verified full-atlas release.
